definition: The cognitive toll accumulated from prolonged BCI use without neural reset cycles — manifests as memory fragmentation, emotional blunting, and involuntary sensory replays. Often goes untreated in lower tiers due to cost of proper neuro-calibration.
origin: Medical slang coined by the Gray Zone-level autodocs, later adopted into broader usage
usage: Used by street medics, BCI technicians, and anyone describing the mental wear of constant connectivity
example: She hadn't slept off-wire in six days — the drift tax was showing in her eyes, that hollow flicker like a bad signal.
